metadata.Description:
Ensure the organization have incident response assistance controls in place.
This control focuses on incident response assistance. It requires the organization to provide an incident response support resource that offers advice and assistance to users of the information system for the handling and reporting of security incidents. The incident response support resource is an integral part of the organization's incident response capability.
metadata.controlTitle: Ensure the organization have incident response assistance controls in place.
